name: DHA+D3 Smart Chews
headline: DHA+D3 Smart Chews
description: Tasty pastilles high in omega-3 DHA (360 mg) and vitamin D3, for cognitive function and immunity. Made in Norway using Concordix technology for higher bioavailability; supports the brain and nervous system, eye health, bones and teeth.
howToUse: Adults – 1 pastille a day with food. Course: 1 month, repeated if needed.

manufacturing.expiration: 20 months from the date of manufacture
manufacturing.storage: Store in a dry place, protected from light, out of reach of children, at a temperature of 15-25°C.
manufacturing.ingredients: Omega-3 fatty acids high in DHA (360 mg) and vitamin D3; chewable fruit-and-citrus pastilles made with Concordix technology.
